# Apopka Water Damage Restoration

> 24/7 emergency water damage restoration in Apopka, FL 32703 and 32712. Crew dispatched immediately. Call (407) 787-9139 now.

## About

Apopka Water Damage Restoration provides 24/7 emergency water damage restoration in Apopka, Florida, ZIP codes 32703 and 32712, in Orange County, Central Florida, between Lake Apopka and the Wekiva River basin. The crew is dispatched immediately, day or night, to extract standing water, find the source and dry the home to IICRC S500 standards. Work covers burst pipes, AC overflows, slab leaks, storm water and sewage backups. Work follows IICRC S500 water damage and S520 mold standards, with daily moisture readings and photo documentation for insurance claims. Mold can begin growing within 24 to 48 hours in Apopka's warm, humid climate. Most homes take three to five days of active drying. Smaller residential jobs often fall somewhere around $1,000 to $3,000, while multi-room losses, sewage backups and jobs that need flooring and drywall replacement commonly run from $3,000 to $10,000 or more. Most Florida homeowners policies cover sudden and accidental water damage; the homeowner files and manages their own claim.

- Emergency water extraction with truck-mount and portable units
- Burst pipe water damage cleanup
- AC leak and air handler overflow cleanup
- Slab leak water damage
- Water heater leak cleanup
- Appliance and toilet overflow cleanup
- Ceiling water damage repair
- Storm and roof leak water damage
- Flood damage cleanup
- Septic and sewage backup cleanup (Category 3 black water)
- Mold remediation and mold inspection
- Structural drying and wet flooring
- Mobile and manufactured home water damage
- Commercial water damage
- Leak detection and water damage insurance claim help
